summary: 2 blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: Oversized single-diff batches are undefined
items.rationale: The current 120000 character invariant cannot be satisfied when one indivisible requirement diff already exceeds the batch limit, so the spec must define that overflow behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1].desc and acceptance_criteria[3] require every batch to stay within 120000 characters without a single-item overflow rule.

items.title: No-file-map fallback conflicts with integration artifact trust
items.rationale: The no-file-map fallback must be scoped so it does not weaken integration gate artifact trust checks that run before requirement evaluation.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc and acceptance_criteria[6] require a no-file-map bulk agent call without qualifying the integration gate trust-input failure path.
